recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if PA decides to regenerate Administration diagram assets or add new out-of-module resources that need the same dotted-box treatment.
issue_request: FHIR-11469 was a Published/Persuasive PA issue asking to improve Administration module diagrams by distinguishing shapes referencing resources from other modules and mentioning those resources as BillableItem had been.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in afc33fcde84154dbff3d0d83cc7bcb3ad9ed8264 on 2016-10-04, which changed images/administration-module-interactions.png, images/source/administration-module-resources.pptx, and source/administration-module.html. The HTML patch replaced the obsolete BillableItem note with text explaining that dotted-box Coverage and Claim resources come from the Finance section. Later 2016 Administration refactoring preserved that applied direction.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml keeps administration-module.html in the current build hierarchy. Current source/administration-module.html includes the interactions diagram and immediately explains the dotted-box convention for Coverage and Claim. The current PNG visually shows Coverage and Claim as dotted/grey boxes, fhir.ini lists coverage and claim as active resources, and BillableItem no longer appears in the current checkout. Later diagram updates changed resource membership but did not contradict the requested convention.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source and diagram already satisfy the Jira request. No diagram-only edit was warranted.

related_jiras.note: A later Administration diagram/resource membership update discovered in git history; it preserved the cross-module dotted-box convention and did not require a FHIR-11469 source change.
